The most fundamental challenge facing asset managers today is the commoditization of public markets. The rise of passive strategies, combined with the inability of many active managers to deliver long-term outperformance, has fueled a steady compression of management fees. In highly liquid products like equities and investment-grade bonds, where low-cost index funds have proliferated, the most logical path to profitability is scale.
